BUREAU OF LEISURE NO. 0029
THE PENROSE ROOM. THE BROADMOOR, COLORADO SPRINGS.
OPENED IN 1961 ATOP THE NEW SOUTH TOWER.
THE RESORT WAS FOUNDED IN 1918 BY SPENCER PENROSE.
REIMAGINED BY TIHANY DESIGN. REOPENED IN 2025.
A LOUNGE LIKE A WESTERN SALOON. THREE DINING ROOMS.
BRING WHOEVER STILL OWNS A BLAZER.
IN A WORD: DEBONAIR.
alt_text: The Penrose Room, The Broadmoor, Colorado Springs. A wood-panelled hotel dining room with teal floral carpet, curved banquettes, brass picture lights and tall windows onto the mountains.
